cleanup.detail: cleanup gate verifies stale temp docs and rejected candidates are removable.

firestore.detail: avatarJobs, userPrivateMedia, candidates, and approval docs are fixture-validated.

gcs.detail: private source, temp, and approved-avatar bucket checks are declared.

gpu.detail: no real GPU is used in dry-run.

oidc.detail: OIDC audience and invoker identity are required for live mode.

previewApproval.detail: preview approval gate is required before production promotion.

queue.detail: Cloud Tasks/PubSub dispatch is not called in dry-run.

tempDocs.detail: temporary candidate docs are expected to be TTL/cleanup bounded.

rollback.data: Do not delete private source media during rollback; cleanup only temp candidates.
rollback.secondary: Scale GPU worker to zero after queue drain or pause dispatch.
